body.x: Canon's featured speaker, Jack Reznicki who is an internationally renowned commercial people and children photographer based in New York City, gave a lecture on lighting, how to see it and handle it at '2014 International CES', the biggest ITappliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
